children: Triple-digit oil prices sound scary, the kind of thing that could torpedo the economy. In fact, oil at $100 is about average this century if you adjust the oil price for overall inflation in the economy. By that measure, oil has averaged around $95 in 2026 prices.
This item is part of a Wall Street Journal live coverage event. The full stream can be found by searching P/WSJL (WSJ Live Coverage).
